indications.description: Locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer.
Adjuvant metastatic colorectal cancer following complete resection.
Adjuvant residual triple-negative breast cancer after neoadjuvant chemotherapy.
Metastatic colorectal cancer and adjuvant treatment after resection of stage II/III colon cancer.

administration.notes: With or within 30 minutes of food. Tablet strengths and final dose require pharmacy dose banding.

treatment_phases.notes: Capecitabine Days 1–14; Days 15–21 tablet-free. Follow the individual prescription.

In moderate/severe renal impairment, uracil phenotyping can be falsely elevated; NCCP advises caution and considering genotype testing. Complete DPD deficiency excludes treatment; partial deficiency has no universal dose percentage in this regimen and consultant-monitored initial titration is distinct from re-escalation after toxicity.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: NCCP low-grade band: 2–3 extra stools/day; source nocturnal-stool wording overlaps grade 2.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: 4–6 extra stools/day or nocturnal stools (NCCP table 4).

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: 7–9 extra stools/day or incontinence (NCCP table 4).

options.label: Grade 4

hand_foot_syndrome_grade.label: Palmar-plantar erythrodysaesthesia (hand-foot syndrome) grade

options.label: Grade 0 — No toxicity
options.description: No hand-foot syndrome.

options.label: Grade 1 — Mild
options.description: NCCP table 5: skin changes/tingling/erythema with discomfort not disrupting normal activities.

options.label: Grade 2 — Moderate
options.description: NCCP table 5: painful erythema/swelling affecting daily activities.

options.label: Grade 3 — Severe
options.description: NCCP table 5: severe skin changes (e.g. desquamation, ulceration, blistering) with pain and inability to work or perform daily activities.

hand_foot_syndrome_grade.assessment_guidance: Use NCCP table 5 clinical descriptions, not a generic CTCAE v5 substitution. Grade 2/3 requires interruption until ≤1; after grade 3 the next dose must be decreased but the table does not specify a percentage.
hand_foot_syndrome_grade.source_grading_note: NCCP table 5 gives regimen-specific hand-foot syndrome descriptions. Grade 2/3 requires interruption until grade ≤1; the subsequent grade-3 reduction is not quantified. These descriptions are not a generic CTCAE v5 substitution.

capecitabine_starting_dose.label: Documented original capecitabine starting prescription (mg/m² twice daily)
capecitabine_starting_dose.assessment_guidance: Use the original prescription before subsequent toxicity reductions. NCCP table 2 gives 75% of original dose for CrCl 30–50; the supplementary SmPC distinguishes 1250 from 1000 mg/m² starts. Other/reduced starts require reconciliation, not an automatic extra reduction.

capecitabine_previous_dose_percent.label: Most recent prescribed capecitabine dose (% of documented starting dose)
capecitabine_previous_dose_percent.assessment_guidance: Enter the most recent prescribed dose before the current interruption, as a percentage of the original documented starting prescription. Include prior toxicity reductions; do not enter 0 for a temporary hold. Unknown history prevents an automatic numeric restart. The general no-re-escalation rule differs from consultant-monitored initial partial-DPD titration.

significant_cardiac_history.label: History of significant cardiac disease, arrhythmia or angina
significant_cardiac_history.assessment_guidance: Supplementary EMA SmPC caution; this is not an automatic dose reduction or routine echocardiography schedule.

current_chest_pain.label: Current chest pain / suspected cardiac ischaemia
current_chest_pain.assessment_guidance: Stop tablets and obtain urgent clinical assessment. A treatment restart must be decided by the consultant; no automatic rechallenge.

dehydration_status.label: Current dehydration / recovery status

options.label: Rehydrated but precipitating cause not corrected/controlled

dehydration_status.assessment_guidance: Supplementary EMA SmPC: interrupt immediately for grade 2 or higher dehydration; restart only after rehydration and correction/control of its cause. This field alone does not authorise restart or determine a dose.

severe_skin_reaction.label: Severe skin reaction during treatment (e.g. SJS/TEN)
severe_skin_reaction.assessment_guidance: Separate serious skin-toxicity stop pathway; not routine hand-foot syndrome.

coumarin_anticoagulant.label: Concomitant coumarin anticoagulant (e.g. warfarin)
coumarin_anticoagulant.assessment_guidance: Supplementary SmPC interaction: close INR/prothrombin-time monitoring and anticoagulant adjustment are needed.

phenytoin_use.label: Concomitant phenytoin
phenytoin_use.assessment_guidance: Supplementary SmPC interaction: monitor phenytoin plasma concentrations and toxicity.

treatment_related_liver_abnormality.label: Elevated liver tests assessed as treatment related
treatment_related_liver_abnormality.assessment_guidance: Distinguish a baseline liver abnormality from treatment-related toxicity. If timing or attribution is uncertain, confirm with the consultant; never assume a missing liver test is normal.
